name: Chipotle Steak
desc: Steak marinated in adobo, ancho chile and cumin, seared in a skillet and chopped like the burrito bowl chain.

source.title: Chipotle Steak (Copycat)
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list (3 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp adobo, 2 tbsp ancho chile powder, 2 tsp each cumin and oregano, 4 lb steak) and the same marinate, sear-to-temperature, rest, and chop steps.

ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp adobo sauce (from a can of chipotle peppers in adobo)
ingredients.note: from a can of chipotle peppers in adobo

ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp olive oil or rice bran oil, plus 2 tbsp more for cooking
ingredients.item: olive oil or rice bran oil

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp salt, plus more to finish
4 lb steak (sirloin, round steak, or flat iron)
ingredients.note: sirloin, round steak, or flat iron

steps: Make the marinade: In a food processor or blender, combine the garlic, adobo sauce, ancho chile powder, 2 tbsp oil, cumin, oregano, 1 tbsp salt, and the pepper. Blend until smooth, adding a little water if needed to blend.

Marinate the steak: Toss the steak with the marinade in a large zip-top bag or bowl. Marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes, or refrigerate up to 12 hours and then let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before cooking.

Cook the steak: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the steak, in batches if needed, and cook, turning occasionally, until it reads 120-125°F for rare or 130-135°F for medium-rare.
Rest and serve: Move the steak to a cutting board, tent with foil, and rest for 10 minutes. Chop into small pieces, season with salt, and serve with rice, beans, guacamole, and salsa.
tips: For more flavor, marinate the steak in the refrigerator overnight (up to 12 hours); that brings the total to about 13 hours.
